name: crossfit-judge-engine
description: CrossFit Judge V2 — Python AI engine (FastAPI + MediaPipe)

scripts.dev: bash -c 'if [ -d venv ]; then source venv/bin/activate; fi; python -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001 --log-level warning'
scripts.start: bash -c 'if [ -d venv ]; then source venv/bin/activate; fi; python -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001 --workers 1 --log-level warning'
